title: Should we be worried about the Broncos minor injury bugs?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Should we be worried about the Broncos minor injury bugs?
sources.description: The preseason is about to begin and the Denver Broncos have been hit with some soft tissue type injuries over the last week. Those tend to be minor, but they can also linger. It will be important for Sean Payton and his staff to manage that issue and get each player ready for Week 1. […]
